sentences.en: Individual atoms can combine with other atoms to form molecules.
sentences.zh: 单个原子可以与其他原子结合形成分子。

sentences.en: Senolytic molecules might one day reduce the effects of aging.
sentences.zh: 清除性分子将来或许能减轻衰老的影响。

sentences.en: I wrote my thesis on amphipathic molecules at the university.
sentences.zh: 我在大学时的论文是关于两亲性分子的研究。

senses.zh: 分子，摩尔；少量，一点儿；微小颗粒，微粒

mnemonic: 词根记忆：mole（=mol堆）+cule（小）→很小的东西堆在一起→分子
